name: Helio Strap
author: lorismaz
description: Movement by day and a sleep coach by night, from an Amazfit Helio Strap: steps, move reminders, sleep, sleep debt and bedtime reminders in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Steps and move reminders during the day; from two hours before bedtime the panel becomes a sleep coach, and a moon in the bar turns red past bedtime.

schema.label: Wake-up Monday
schema.description: 24-hour time like 07:00, or free for a morning without an alarm (the plan then allows at most an hour's lie-in). Bedtime each evening follows the next morning.

schema.label: Measure time to fall asleep
schema.description: Learns how long you take to fall asleep from the strap's minute data (median of the last 14 nights, after 5 complete nights).

schema.label: Minutes to fall asleep (when not measured)
Bedtime reminders
schema.description: A wind-down notice an hour before bedtime, a bedtime notice, then two reminders while you are still at the computer, plus a morning summary.

schema.label: Maximum heart rate
schema.description: Sets the five heart rate zones. A common estimate is 220 minus your age.

schema.label: Move reminders
schema.description: While you're at the computer, a nudge after sitting too long. Walking the set number of steps clears it.

schema.label: Steps that count as moving (within 10 minutes)
Your strap (Bluetooth address)
schema.description: Set from the panel when you confirm which paired strap is yours. Only this strap is followed; nothing is read from any strap until one is confirmed.

schema.label: Strap name contains
schema.description: Follows the first paired Bluetooth device whose name contains this text. Leave empty to use any paired heart rate strap.

schema.label: Reconnect automatically
schema.description: Try to reconnect the strap every 30 seconds while it is disconnected.

schema.label: Show the zone next to the heart rate
